body.statement: For every revealed \(d_n\)-regular graph with \(M_n<n\), the seed design and observed-data Rao--Blackwell estimator are unbiased for \(\tau_n\), and \[Q_G=\sum_{r=1}^{k_n}\binom{k_n}{r}K_G^{\circ r}\succeq0,\qquad \sup_{y\in\mathcal M_n(G)}\mathbb E[(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{seed}}-\tau_n)^2\mid G]\le U(G,k_n).\] Every entry of \(Q_G\), every weight \(w_i(z;G)\), and the certificate are finite graph computations from \(G\) and \(k_n\).
body.justification: The exact Schur-power identity is the two-arm covariance mechanism that prevents the control estimator from paying the generic conflict spectral radius.
body.gap: KandirosEtAl2024ConflictGraph, Theorem 4.1, uses randomized priority resolution and a generic conflict-graph norm; UganderYin2023RGCR, Theorem 4.8, studies bounded outcomes within randomized cluster designs. Neither gives this endpoint-\(L_2\) certificate.
body.consumer: A revealed network can be randomized once and audited before outcomes arrive by evaluating the displayed graph-only certificate.
